\noindent\textbf{Figure 3.} Instrumentation in the release, one exemplar each, drawn through bone. (a) Hip arthroplasty, 66, $n=8$. (b) Femoral-neck screws, 68, $n=1$. (c) Sacroiliac screws, 67, $n=1$. (d) Interbody cages, 63, $n=1$. Bar, 5\,cm.

\noindent\textbf{Figure 4.} Count-free measures. (a) Vertebrae between the lowest rib and the sacrum. (b) Lowest rib length over the rib above. (c) Lowest lumbar transverse span against its gap to the ala; transitional labels marked.

\noindent\textbf{Figure 6.} Morphometry by level, T11--L5, as median, interquartile range and 5th--95th percentile, with $n$ at right. (a) Endplate width. (b) Canal, width and depth.
